detail.longDescription: If you let a coding agent keep persistent memory, it will quietly grow a second copy of things you already wrote down. Mine (Claude) reached 93 files. Four of them were the same rule in different words — I wrote the fourth that afternoon with the other three in context. 78% of the store belonged in a skill, a wiki page or an issue instead. https:// rasputin.geekdojo.com/devlog/0 11-agent-memory-audit/ # selfhosted # homelab # Anthropic
